title: Skin patch that collects sweat could predict ovulation | New Scientist
description: A patch that measures levels of two reproductive hormones in sweat has shown promise for predicting ovulation in a small study
author: Rachel Melegrito

title: OpenAI agent hacked an Australian government healthcare website | New Scientist
description: There has been a string of incidents reported over the past few months where AI agents have hacked companies. Now, a case involving a government website has been revealed for the first time
author: James Woodford

title: Future of Amazon rainforest may hinge on Brazil presidential election | New Scientist
description: A general election in Brazil next month is widely seen as a choice between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro
author: Luke Taylor

title: When will the AMOC collapse? We don't know, but should still prepare | New Scientist
description: Uncertainty about when or even if the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, a vital ocean current, might collapse has been an excuse to ignore the risk, but that actually makes it even more important that we act now
author: New Scientist

title: Lifestyle changes may be as effective as therapy at easing depression | New Scientist
description: Advice about mindful eating, enjoying exercise and getting good-quality sleep was at least as effective for treating depression as cognitive behavioural therapy
author: Mary West

title: Severe meningitis outbreak caused by bacteria that took genes from microbiome | New Scientist
description: An unprecedented meningitis outbreak that occurred in Kent, UK, in March seems to have been driven by a bacterial strain taking genes from harmless microbes
author: Carissa Wong
